pages.text: GT ore comes in veins: big clusters (about 40 to 50 blocks wide) of several ores at once. Each vein has a weight, a height range and a dimension. Mine the whole cluster, it holds more than one material.
Veins are placed on a grid of 3 chunks, with up to 12 blocks of random offset (pack config). Ore indicators are on: Surface Rocks of a material mark where a vein lies below.
Surface Rocks: break one to get 3 Tiny Piles of the dust (Fortune adds more). Look for them on the ground, then dig down in that area.
In JEI, the 'Show GT Ore Veins' button lists every vein: ores inside, Weight, Spawn Range and Dimensions.
